primitives.name: Control Family Applicability Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Purpose Lists the ISO 27001 Annex A control families that `CONTROL_LIBRARY` (`packages/compliance/src/control-library.ts`) currently touches, with applicability and justification columns for a real ISMS owner to complete.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A': 'Annex A control family identifier (dimensionless)', 'S': 'ISMS scope (dimensionless)', 'C': 'Control library entry (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: The control library subset reflects current automation capabilities; applicability is binary (Yes/No).
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S ∩ C ≠ ∅, constraint is active; otherwise inactive.

layer2.mapping: Each control family A maps to a probabilistic applicability function P(A|S,C), where S is ISMS scope and C is control library coverage.
layer2.telemetry: Binary flag indicating whether control A is applicable within scope S under CCM automation.

primitives.name: Control Justification Function
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Justification**: why the control is (or isn't) applicable to this ISMS scope (see `ISMS_SCOPE.md`).
primitives.assumptions: Justification is derived from alignment between A and S; may be qualitative or quantitative.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When J < threshold, control is deemed inapplicable to S.

layer2.mapping: J = f(S, A) encodes logical consistency between control family and ISMS scope.
layer2.telemetry: Qualitative or quantitative score indicating alignment between A and S.

primitives.name: Automated Control Coverage
primitives.verbatim_quote: This is deliberately a subset of the full Annex A control set — it reflects only the controls this CCM currently automates, not a full Annex A coverage review.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_subset': 'Subset of controls automated by CCM (dimensionless)', 'C_full': 'Full set of Annex A controls (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: CCM automation is limited to a subset of full control set.
primitives.breakdown_regime: C_subset ⊂ C_full, with potential for expansion.

layer2.mapping: Automated coverage is modeled as a set inclusion map C_subset → C_full, with cardinality ratio |C_subset|/|C_full|.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of automated controls to total controls in Annex A.

The Statement of Applicability (SoA) defines a structured framework for evaluating ISO 27001 control families against an Information Security Management System (ISMS) scope. The core operators are: (1) Applicability Constraint, which determines whether a control family A is relevant to the ISMS scope S based on its intersection with CCM automation; (2) Justification Function, which evaluates the logical alignment between A and S through a derived metric J; and (3) Automated Coverage, which quantifies how much of the full control set is covered by CCM. These primitives form a dual structure: the applicability constraint acts as a filter, while the justification function provides semantic grounding. Failure modes include misalignment between A and S, or over-coverage of controls beyond automation scope. The system operates under probabilistic constraints where P(A|S,C) governs applicability, and J = f(S,A) ensures contextual relevance.
